title: The Red Field
summary: This is Legora's quiet closing panel, made red: a square red field inset margin to margin on paper, with the Index Spine running straight through it. The panel hangs from an opening rule that turns into the Kelwin mark's outer corner, and it closes on a second spine joint wired into the primary door. Inside sit an 88px sentence plus a light muted sentence, the two doors alone at bottom-left and the hero's quiet ledger with one row open. The close reads as a calm, institutional decision instead of today's HUD terminal.

reference.borrowed: A single square-cornered dark panel with almost nothing in it. A one-line question in ink and a muted follow-up sentence sit top-left. One small solid button sits alone at bottom-left. Most of the panel stays empty, and a cropped brand glyph hugs the top-right corner as the only ornament.
reference.kelwin: The dark panel becomes B's one red inset (data-surface red, 1312×660, square) on a paper section. The two-tone voice becomes B's statement at 88px wide: 'Initiate the / System Audit.' in paper, then 'What we build, / you keep.' at the light weight in paper --fg-3, followed by the short paper rule. The lone button becomes the two doors in the founder's tracked caps with drawn arrows: the paper 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' with red text (to /audit) and the underlined 'TALK TO THE TEAM →' (to /contact). The cropped glyph becomes the mark as hairline structure. B's opening rule leaves the spine at a 6px paper joint square, runs to the top-right, turns down and steps out to the edge. That traces K1's inner contour, so the panel's own corner stands in for K1's outer edge, and K2's L and the K3 core sit inside it in 1px paper lines at master proportions (1.6px per unit). A second joint on the spine is stubbed into the primary door, so the act closes on the index line where it opened. The spine column holds only the light '13' and the mono 'Decision'. Bottom-right, cols 10–12, the hero's ledger returns under '■ Deployment window open'. It has three rows (Fixed scope · Ten working days · The readout is yours), and exactly one row is open: 'Kickoff to readout. Fixed scope, fixed end date.' All of it is real audit copy from the live site.

motion: entrance (the one orchestrated moment): the red unfolds out of the spine. The panel opens by clip-path from a zero-width slit on the spine to both margins (1100ms --ease-inout), the way a page would hang from its index line. The statement is already rising 12px inside the field as it opens (800ms, with the light sentence 160ms behind), so the reveal carries the words rather than a blank slab.

then the panel hangs from its rule. The top joint appears and the opening rule plots from the spine across and down the corner (1100ms stroke-dashoffset), followed by the K2 L (800ms) and the K3 core (600ms). The '13' fades in. The paper rule draws at about 1.0s, the ledger rules draw left to right with their text fading in (60ms stagger), and the doors fade up together with the second spine joint at about 1.15s.
ledger: at about 1.8s the second row ('Ten working days') opens in place (height plus opacity, 360ms --ease-inout), and its '+' turns to '−'. All motion ends by about 2.2s.

interaction: rows open one at a time on click, and a hovered row's content shifts 8px right. The paper door goes to blush on hover with ↗ moving 2px. The contact link's paper underline draws in from the left (300ms) and its → moves 3px. Nothing loops.
on the live site: the unfold runs once when the panel is 50% visible, and the spine index stays sticky through the section as everywhere in B. Reduced motion shows the final state with row 2 open.
notes: 916px tall: 128 + 660 + 128. The spine is one hairline at the col 3|4 gutter (x=386), ink --line on paper and paper --line inside the red panel. The opening rule traces the master mark's K1 inner contour (bars at 1.6px per unit) and K2 + K3 sit inside it as 1px outlines at the master proportions (K2 94×38 + 39×92, K3 42×38), so it reads as the logo built in rule. Panel content keeps the page grid (statement, rule and doors start at col 4). B's only full red is this inset panel; on it the label square, rule and primary invert to paper. Coherence pass: the mono spine name became the shared red-square caps label (paper square on red), padding 160 → 128, head offsets to the shared 44px rule gap.
